title: Clad Size-aware: 3D Body Scanning for Virtual Fitting
summary: A commercial 3D body scanning pipeline that extracts ISO-compliant measurements from mesh models for virtual fitting rooms. It utilizes permissive models like Naver’s Anny and Meta’s MHR to provide high-accuracy shape reconstruction without restrictive licensing.
research_notes: Utilizes physics-aware loss functions to achieve a 0.3kg mean mass error. Operates at a cost of approximately $0.09 per scan.

evolution.summary: The project transitioned from research-focused SMPL models to a cost-effective commercial pipeline using Apache-licensed foundations like Anny and MHR. It recently open-sourced the 'clad-body' measurement library and is pivoting to questionnaire-based shape prediction to minimize user friction.
